nodes.name: state.rs
nodes.summary: ExtractMemoriesState tracks per-session extraction progress (last processed message index, in-progress flag, turns since last extraction, and stashed pending messages) with a serializable snapshot for status reporting.

nodes.name: frontmatter.rs
nodes.summary: Parses the YAML-style frontmatter header (key: value lines between --- delimiters) at the top of a workspace-memory markdown file.

nodes.name: lock.rs
nodes.summary: File-based mutex (a .consolidate-lock file plus mtime bookkeeping) that prevents the auto-dream consolidation job from running concurrently across processes, including stale-PID detection and rollback on failure.

nodes.name: manifest.rs
nodes.summary: Scans the workspace-memory directory recursively into a list of MemoryHeader entries, formats them into the MEMORY.md manifest with freshness annotations, and loads/truncates the index file itself.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Root of the L2 workspace-scoped memory system (markdown files with YAML frontmatter under .orgii/workspace-memory/): defines MemoryType and MemoryHeader, workspace path helpers, a personal-workspace migration routine, and re-exports auto_dream/extract/lock/prefetch/surface_state plus flattened frontmatter/manifest helpers.

nodes.name: prefetch.rs
nodes.summary: Session-start memory prefetch: an LLM side-query (select_relevant_headers) picks the most relevant workspace-memory files for the user's first message, with an offline fallback, then assembles the memory protocol/prompt sections injected into the agent system prompt.

nodes.name: prompt_sections.rs
nodes.summary: Static, eval-validated prompt-text constants describing memory types, save/skip guidance, and access rules, exposed via how_to_save_section for injection into the agent system prompt.

nodes.name: surface_state.rs
nodes.summary: WorkspaceMemorySurfaceState tracks which memory file paths have already been surfaced to the agent within a session (bounded insertion-ordered dedup set) plus a running injected-byte budget.

nodes.name: ExtractMemoriesState
nodes.summary: Per-session state for the memory-extraction gate: last processed message index, in-progress flag, turns since extraction, and stashed pending messages.

nodes.name: ExtractMemoriesStateSnapshot
nodes.summary: Serializable snapshot of ExtractMemoriesState for status reporting to the frontend.

nodes.name: parse_frontmatter
nodes.summary: Parses the leading --- delimited YAML-style frontmatter block of a workspace-memory markdown file into a key/value map.

nodes.name: read_last_consolidated_at
nodes.summary: Reads the lock file's modification time as the last-consolidated-at timestamp for a workspace.

nodes.name: hours_since_last_consolidation
nodes.summary: Computes elapsed hours since the last recorded consolidation for a workspace, used by auto-dream gating.

nodes.name: try_acquire
nodes.summary: Attempts to atomically acquire the consolidation lock, checking for and clearing stale locks held by dead processes.

nodes.name: rollback
nodes.summary: Restores the lock file's prior modification time if a consolidation attempt fails after acquiring the lock.

nodes.name: record_consolidation
nodes.summary: Updates the lock file's mtime to mark a successful consolidation completion.

nodes.name: read_lock_state
nodes.summary: Reads and parses the lock file contents to determine the holder PID and acquisition time.

nodes.name: is_process_running
nodes.summary: Checks whether a given PID currently corresponds to a live process, used to detect stale locks.

nodes.name: set_file_mtime
nodes.summary: Sets a file's modification time to a specific millisecond timestamp, used for lock rollback and recording.

nodes.name: scan_memory_files
nodes.summary: Recursively scans a workspace-memory directory and returns MemoryHeader entries sorted by most-recently-modified.

nodes.name: scan_recursive
nodes.summary: Recursive directory walker collecting markdown files and parsing their frontmatter into headers.

nodes.name: format_memory_manifest
nodes.summary: Formats a list of memory headers into the markdown manifest block used in prompts and the MEMORY.md index.

nodes.name: format_timestamp_iso
nodes.summary: Converts a millisecond epoch timestamp into an ISO-8601 formatted date/time string without relying on chrono for this hot path.

nodes.name: load_memory_index
nodes.summary: Loads and parses the MEMORY.md index file for a workspace, falling back gracefully when absent.

nodes.name: truncate_entrypoint
nodes.summary: Truncates the MEMORY.md index content to the configured maximum line count before prompt injection.

nodes.name: memory_age_days
nodes.summary: Computes a memory file's age in whole days from its mtime.

nodes.name: memory_age
nodes.summary: Computes a memory file's age as a duration from its mtime.

nodes.name: memory_freshness_text
nodes.summary: Formats a memory file's mtime into a human-readable freshness label for prompt display.

nodes.name: memory_dir
nodes.summary: Computes the .orgii/workspace-memory/ directory path for a given workspace root.

nodes.name: is_memory_path
nodes.summary: Checks whether a given file path lies inside a workspace's memory directory.

nodes.name: migrate_personal_workspace_memory
nodes.summary: One-time migration routine that moves legacy personal-workspace memory files into the current memory directory layout.

nodes.name: build_memory_policy
nodes.summary: Builds the effective memory policy (limits/toggles) used to gate prefetch, extraction, and auto-dream for the current session.

nodes.name: MemoryType
nodes.summary: Enum classifying a workspace-memory file: User, Feedback, Workspace, or Reference.

nodes.name: MemoryHeader
nodes.summary: Scanned metadata for one workspace-memory file: filename, path, mtime, description, and memory type.

nodes.name: select_memories
nodes.summary: Main prefetch entry point: scans available memory headers and uses an LLM side-query to select the subset most relevant to the user's first message, respecting a byte budget.

nodes.name: select_memories_offline
nodes.summary: Offline fallback for memory prefetch that selects recent memory headers without an LLM call when no provider is available.

nodes.name: select_relevant_headers
nodes.summary: Issues the LLM side-query asking it to pick the most relevant memory filenames from the manifest given the user query and recent tool activity.

nodes.name: extract_recent_tools_from_history
nodes.summary: Extracts a de-duplicated list of recently used tool names from the conversation history to give the selection LLM extra context.

nodes.name: parse_selected_filenames
nodes.summary: Parses the LLM's selection response text into a list of chosen memory filenames.

nodes.name: load_selected_memories
nodes.summary: Loads the file contents for the selected memory headers, up to a maximum count and byte budget.

nodes.name: truncate_memory_to_file_budget
nodes.summary: Truncates a single memory file's content to stay within its allotted portion of the prompt byte budget.

nodes.name: build_memory_protocol_section
nodes.summary: Assembles the "how memory works" protocol section of the system prompt, describing save/access rules.

nodes.name: build_memory_prompt_section
nodes.summary: Assembles the final memory prompt section injected into the agent system prompt, combining the manifest and selected memory contents.

nodes.name: RelevantMemory
nodes.summary: A memory file selected during prefetch, paired with its path, mtime, content, and freshness label.

nodes.name: how_to_save_section
nodes.summary: Returns the static, eval-validated prompt text instructing the agent how and when to save workspace-memory files.

nodes.name: WorkspaceMemorySurfaceState
nodes.summary: Bounded, insertion-ordered set of memory paths already surfaced to the agent this session, plus a running injected-byte counter, used to avoid re-injecting the same memory twice.
